field_pickl_venue_sec_body:
The Original keeps it classic: double patty, cheese, dill pickles, white onion, mustard, ketchup. The New Yorker brings tomato, lettuce and secret sauce. The Jeff turns the heat up with feel the heat spice, fried onions and ranch. The BBQ Bacon Burger stacks bacon, fried onions, BBQ and ranch. The Buffalo goes buffalo sauce, ranch and parmesan. Grain-fed chuck, smashed, potato bun, every single time. Can't pick? Build Your Own, single or double.

Not a cheeseburger day? The Legendary Patty Melt is the beef one, The Legendary Chicken Melt the chicken one. We named them, so we're allowed.

Fresh chicken breast, breaded by hand and fried the moment you order it, on a potato bun with dill pickles, lettuce and comeback sauce. Pick your heat: plain, medium-ish, feel the heat or Nashville. Brave enough for the reaper? Dine in, and sign the waiver first.

field_pickl_venue_sec_heading: Plant-based at Pickl City Walk? Plenty.
field_pickl_venue_sec_body:
The Original, The New Yorker, The Jeff and The Buffalo all come in a plant-based version too, suitable for vegetarians. Build Your Own does too, with Plant-Based Fries on the side.

The Rocket Parma Salad is the green thing on the menu that isn't a pickle. Adding fries to it is allowed.

field_pickl_venue_sec_heading: Homegrown, and still done the hard way.
field_pickl_venue_sec_body: Pickl started in Dubai and still runs from here. Sauces, spice blends and pickles are made fresh every day, and the beef and chicken come with no hormones, no preservatives and no additives.
